note: One-shot live auto-trade. Fires at most ONE defined-risk structure on armed_date: best passing candidate in priority order condor > bull put > fly, max loss <= max_loss, re-priced + drift-guarded at fill, idempotent via Alpaca client_order_id. To re-arm another day, change armed_date (or set env AUTO_TRADE_DATE). Kill switch: set env AUTO_TRADE_KILL=1, or enabled=false.
